account.title: Account
account.intro: Your profile, password and API keys.

account.keys.revokeFailed: That API key could not be revoked: it is not one of yours, or it no longer exists.

account.changePassword.required: An administrator set your password. Choose your own before you go on.
account.changePassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.changePassword.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
